segments.oily: Reviewers describe it as suited to normal-to-oily or combination-oily skin, clearing pores and controlling breakouts without over-drying, though one combination-oily reviewer still noted flaking with twice-daily use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report no stripping and a soft, non-tight finish, but a few say it is drying or not suitable for dry skin and recommend cutting back to a few times a week.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or between-oily-and-dry skin call it a good treatment/second cleanser that leaves skin smoother, though one found it a little drying for her skin type.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers say it did not irritate or break them out and left skin smooth and refreshed, but others advise sensitive users to ease in gradually or note it may not be good for very sensitive skin.
segments.mature: One long-term user credits over a decade of use with fewer wrinkles and breakouts, though she rates the reformulated version lower than the original.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports few wrinkles after long-term use of the older formula, but her rating of the current formula is lower.
concerns.dehydration: Many say the cleanser does not leave skin dry or tight and pairs well with moisturizer; several others explicitly describe dryness, tightness, or flaking, especially with frequent use.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report reduced redness and less inflammation with continued use; no dissenting reports of increased redness were found.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers highlight that it cleans deeply without stripping or causing tightness; one reformulation critic instead reports her face never feels clean now.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers say dark spots or blemish marks lessened in appearance with use; this is reported by a minority of reviewers relative to overall breakout comments.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority report fewer breakouts, reduced blemishes, and calmer skin over one to several weeks; a smaller group says the new formula did nothing for acne or that breakouts returned.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin say it helps keep pores clear and oil managed; no reports of increased oiliness were found.

This is a great product, I love how smooth my skin feels after using it, and I do agree it is a great 2nd cleanser to the routine. It is absolutely a little drying to my skin type, thus the 4-star rating for me specifically (I have a more balanced skin type/between oily and dry). But! The treatment part has been working for me- the exfoliation is great and my skin feels smoother! As a heads up, I don't think it's meant as the best cleanser to use to take makeup off- I do NOT recommend using this on the eyes. It's great as a treatment/2nd cleanser! While using a moisturizer alongside it, this is a great product and I've been enjoying using it!

I like that it's just 1%. Overall a solid choice for a salicylic cleanser that I'd purchase next time.
